frags.sent: Length conversion is adding 1.5 sizes when going from men's to women's or subtracting 1.5 sizes when going from women's to men's. frags.sent: Our women's shoes start at a size 5, which is equivalent to a big kid's size 3.5 in length. To find your child's size in women's, add 1.5 to the big kid's size.
